in exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of the election commission Act
1957 [Act 31], the Yang di-pertuan Agong makes the following regulations:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Election Commission (Amendment
of Schedule) Regulations 2010.
 (2) These regulations are deemed to have come into operation on 10 march
Amendment of Schedule
2. The schedule to the Act is amended—
 (a) in paragraph 1—
 (i) by substituting for the figure "11,164.94" the figure "12,523.75";
and
 (ii) by substituting for the figure "9,480.90" the figure
"10,270.05";
 (b) in paragraph 7—
 (i) by substituting for the figure "2,000" the figure "2,500"; and
 (ii) by substituting for the figure "1,300" the figure "1,600";
 (c) in paragraph 9, by substituting for the figure "60,000" the figure
"70,000";
 (d) in paragraph 10—
 (i) by inserting after the word " chairman" the words "and Deputy
chairman"; and
 (ii) by substituting for the words "Deputy chairman and members"
the word "members";
 (e) in paragraph 12—
 (i) by substituting for the figure "4,000" the figure "5,000"; and
 (ii) by substituting for the figure "2,500" the figure "3,050";
P.U. (A) 118. P.U. (A) 118-119.
 (f) in paragraph 18 in the item " chairman", by substituting for the figure
"2,000" the figure "3,000"; and
 (g) in paragraph 19 in the item " chairman", by substituting for the figure
"500" the figure "1,000".

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Cukai
Pendapatan (Elaun Bangunan Industri) (Bangunan di bawah Projek
Penswastaan dan Inisiatif Pembiayaan Swasta) 2010.
 (2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini hendaklah berkuat kuasa mulai tahun taksiran
Bangunan industri bagi maksud Jadual 3 Akta
2. Di bawah Kaedah-Kaedah ini, suatu bangunan yang dibina—
 (a) di bawah suatu projek penswastaan dan inisiatif pembiayaan swasta
yang diluluskan oleh jawatankuasa penswastaan/ pFi, Unit Kerjasama
Awam swasta, jabatan perdana menteri; dan
 (b) menurut suatu perjanjian yang ditandatangani antara seseorang dengan
Kerajaan malaysia atau suatu badan berkanun berasaskan bina-
pajak-senggara-pindah dan yang baginya tiada balasan dibayar oleh
Kerajaan malaysia atau badan berkanun itu kepada orang itu,
hendaklah dianggap sebagai suatu bangunan industri bagi maksud jadual 3
Akta.
P.U. (A) 118. P.U. (A) 118-119.
